meaning: wood; a piece of wood (also: a blockhead)

senses.en: wood; a piece of wood (also: a blockhead)

examples.zh: 这张桌子是木头做的。
examples.en: This table is made of wood.

examples.zh: 别把木头放在雨里。
examples.en: Don't leave the wood out in the rain.

examples.zh: 他一句话也不说，真像木头。
examples.en: He didn't say a word, like a block of wood.

meaning: to announce publicly; to publish (results, a list, a decision)

senses.en: to announce publicly; to publish (results, a list, a decision)

note: Used for official or public information: 公布成绩, 公布名单.

examples.zh: 学校明天会公布考试成绩。
examples.en: The school will announce the exam results tomorrow.

examples.zh: 医院还没公布结果吗？
examples.en: Hasn't the hospital released the results yet?

examples.zh: 请不要公布我的电话。
examples.en: Please don't make my phone number public.

note: Goes before the verb or adjective; the result matches a prediction.

examples.zh: 天气预报说会下雨，果然下了。
examples.en: The forecast said rain, and sure enough it rained.

examples.zh: 我早就说他会晚来，他果然来晚了。
examples.en: I said he'd be late, and sure enough he was.

examples.zh: 朋友说这家菜很好吃，我吃了果然不错。
examples.en: A friend said the food here is good, and sure enough it is.

examples.zh: 医生说他的病会好，他很乐观。
examples.en: The doctor said he'll recover, and he is very optimistic.

examples.zh: 你太不乐观了，事情没有你想的那么难。
examples.en: You're too pessimistic; it isn't as hard as you think.

examples.zh: 我对这次考试比较乐观。
examples.en: I'm fairly optimistic about this exam.

meaning: so far; to this day; until now

senses.en: so far; to this day; until now

note: Before the verb; usually with 还, 没, or 仍然 for a state that continues.

examples.zh: 他十年前出国，至今没有回家。
examples.en: He went abroad ten years ago and still hasn't come home.

examples.zh: 这个问题至今没有人知道。
examples.en: Still nobody knows the answer to this question.

examples.zh: 我至今还记得第一次见她的样子。
examples.en: I still remember what she looked like when I first met her.

meaning: to rise; to go up (prices, temperature, numbers)

senses.en: to rise; to go up (prices, temperature, numbers)

examples.zh: 这个月的价格又上升了。
examples.en: Prices went up again this month.

examples.zh: 天气变热，气温开始上升。
examples.en: The weather is getting hot and temperatures are starting to rise.

examples.zh: 飞机慢慢上升，我的头有点儿疼。
examples.en: The plane climbed slowly and my head hurt a little.

meaning: a talented person; talent (people with skills)

senses.en: a talented person; talent (people with skills)

note: Refers to skilled people as a group or individual, e.g. 技术人才.

examples.zh: 公司需要更多的技术人才。
examples.en: The company needs more technical talent.

examples.zh: 这个城市想要年轻人才来工作。
examples.en: This city wants young talent to come and work here.

examples.zh: 我们正在找会说汉语的人才，你来吗？
examples.en: We are looking for talented Chinese speakers. Will you join us?

examples.zh: 老师因为他没做作业批评了他。
examples.en: The teacher criticized him for not doing his homework.

examples.zh: 我被经理批评了一次。
examples.en: I was criticized by the manager once.

examples.zh: 谢谢你的批评，我会改的。
examples.en: Thanks for your criticism; I'll change.

meaning: in depth; thorough; to go deep into

senses.en: in depth; thorough; to go deep into

examples.zh: 我们明天深入讨论这个问题。
examples.en: Tomorrow let's discuss this issue in depth.

examples.zh: 这本书对汉字有很深入的介绍。
examples.en: This book gives a very thorough introduction to Chinese characters.

examples.zh: 你对这个城市认识得深入吗？
examples.en: Do you know this city well?

meaning: to overcome (difficulties, fear, a bad habit)

senses.en: to overcome (difficulties, fear, a bad habit)

examples.zh: 他克服了许多困难，终于会游泳了。
examples.en: He overcame many difficulties and can finally swim.

examples.zh: 我怕说汉语，怎么才能克服呢？
examples.en: I'm afraid to speak Chinese. How can I get over it?

examples.zh: 住在国外，要克服很想家的感觉。
examples.en: Living abroad, you have to overcome the feeling of homesickness.

examples.zh: 医生给他做了一次全面检查。
examples.en: The doctor gave him a comprehensive checkup.

examples.zh: 你对这件事的看法不够全面。
examples.en: Your view of this matter isn't comprehensive enough.

examples.zh: 这份报告很全面，谢谢你。
examples.en: This report is very thorough. Thank you.

note: Also means to plan or scheme, but the numbers sense is the everyday one.

examples.zh: 请帮我计算，一共多少钱。
examples.en: Please work out how much it comes to altogether.

examples.zh: 我用手机计算这个月花了多少钱。
examples.en: I am using my phone to work out how much I spent this month.

examples.zh: 这道题不难，你自己计算吧。
examples.en: This problem isn't hard; work it out yourself.

examples.zh: 早睡早起对身体有利。
examples.en: Going to bed and getting up early is good for your health.

examples.zh: 这个变化对我们很有利。
examples.en: This change is very favorable to us.

examples.zh: 这样做对大家都有利。
examples.en: Doing it this way benefits everyone.

note: Takes a bad outcome as object: 防止迟到, 防止生病.

examples.zh: 为了防止来晚，我六点就起床了。
examples.en: To avoid being late, I got up at six.

examples.zh: 多喝水可以防止生病。
examples.en: Drinking more water helps prevent illness.

examples.zh: 请把门关上，防止猫跑出去。
examples.en: Please shut the door so the cat doesn't run out.

examples.zh: 这套家具是新买的。
examples.en: This set of furniture is newly bought.

examples.zh: 我们的新家还没有家具。
examples.en: Our new home doesn't have any furniture yet.

examples.zh: 搬家的时候，他把旧家具都卖了。
examples.en: When he moved, he sold all his old furniture.

examples.zh: 我的工作基本上做好了。
examples.en: My work is basically done.

examples.zh: 这两个菜基本上一样。
examples.en: These two dishes are basically the same.

examples.zh: 他基本上每天都骑自行车上班。
examples.en: He basically cycles to work every day.

meaning: to unfold; to launch or carry out (a discussion, a campaign)

senses.en: to unfold; to launch or carry out (a discussion, a campaign)

examples.zh: 他把地图展开，找我们在哪儿。
examples.en: He unfolded the map to find where we were.

examples.zh: 大家对这个问题展开了讨论。
examples.en: Everyone started a discussion on this issue.

examples.zh: 公司下个月要展开一次调查。
examples.en: The company will launch a survey next month.

examples.zh: 这个月游客的数量越来越多。
examples.en: The number of tourists is growing this month.

examples.zh: 这种药的数量不多。
examples.en: There isn't much of this medicine.

examples.zh: 买东西，好不好比数量重要。
examples.en: When you shop, whether it is good matters more than how much.

note: Used for two parties in a deal, match, or dispute.

examples.zh: 买房子的时候，双方都要写名字。
examples.en: When buying a house, both parties must write their names.

examples.zh: 比赛结束了，双方握手。
examples.en: The match ended and both sides shook hands.

examples.zh: 这件事对双方都有好处。
examples.en: This is good for both sides.

note: Pattern: 和/跟 A 相比, B ...

examples.zh: 和去年相比，今年冷多了。
examples.en: Compared with last year, this year is much colder.

examples.zh: 两家店相比，这家更便宜。
examples.en: Comparing the two shops, this one is cheaper.

examples.zh: 跟他相比，我的汉语还不够好。
examples.en: Compared with him, my Chinese isn't good enough yet.
